Mbed TLS 2.28.8, Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE).
Upstream source: https://github.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls/tree/v2.28.8

This copy supplies a private TLS implementation for optional 3DSRP statistics.
The configuration adds USAGE_PRIVATE_TLS_BUILD, enabling restartable ECC and
using caller-supplied native PS random bytes rather than platform entropy.
Unused platform network and timing modules are disabled for the private build.
No certificate or hostname verification is disabled.

Build artifacts are symbol-namespaced by 3ds/usage-tls/namespace.py. The existing
Chiaki/core devkitPro crypto library, configuration and ABI remain unchanged.
The sender requires ECDHE-ECDSA / AES-128-GCM with TLS 1.2, advances ECC in short
resumable slices, and uses its own nonblocking sockets and configured DNS server.
Tests, programs and upstream documentation not needed by this build are omitted.
Original source copyright/license notices are retained.
